byte_order: big-endian CDB and reply integers, raw page bytes unchanged

fields: sticky error; zero means no recorded error
current sector token; zero before arm
reply.identity_exception: FC78: echo@0, HYW1@2, version1@6, flags0@7, slotBE32@8, span32768BE32@12

commands.name: identity
commands.effect: Private RAM only; entry and identity perform no MMIO.

commands.name: initialize
commands.effect: Explicit reader-derived SPI setup, exact JEDEC and status checks; no WREN or status-register writes. Raw SR1/SR2 retained in FD88 audit record.

commands.name: arm_sector
commands.effect: Read all 4096 bytes and compare preimage CRC before issuing a fresh nonzero token and sequence1. No NVM mutation.

commands.name: erase_sector
commands.effect: Initial target gate0 refuses before WREN. Operational path requires an already frozen and echoed first page, then second sector-preimage check; consume authorization before one4KiB erase. Read back every erased byte.

commands.name: stage_page
commands.effect: Receive256 raw page bytes plus CRC32BE into guarded RX RAM; require observed MINI return260, copy to distinct frozen page, validate CRC. STAGE is allowed after ARM before ERASE, or after ERASE; never WREN. Query FC7E and compare FD87 byte-for-byte before FC7D. No IN answer to OUT.

commands.name: program_staged_page
commands.effect: Target initial gate0 refuses before WREN. Operational host-tested path requires emitted FD87 echo, aligned unused page in erased sector, frozen CRC/guard and erased preimage; consumes page before WREN, programs once, bounded WIP/status and all256-byte readback. Host must explicitly compare echo bytes before issuing this command.

commands.name: status
commands.effect: Return retained RAM status; never clears an error or repeats an operation.

commands.name: readback
commands.effect: Raw bounded read wholly within the application range. No other physical or CPU address space is exposed.

commands.name: finish_sector
commands.effect: Require all16 pages verified, read4096 bytes, match target CRC, invalidate the token and retain final result. No automatic next-sector arm.

commands.name: echo_frozen_page
commands.effect: Send exact frozen256-byte page with no NVM access. Does not consume operation sequence; host must compare all bytes. A later ERASE may advance current_sequence without changing staging_sequence.

commands.name: retained_audit_record
commands.effect: RAM-only HYW1 record:128LE bytes; CRC32[0:120]@120, DONE@124. No new NOR read or clear of sticky error.

sequence_rules: One active sector at a time; token and sequence must not wrap or be reused during a session.
Every accepted erase/stage/program/finish consumes exactly current_sequence+1 before its first external callback or SPI action. Sequence restarts at1 only under a fresh sector token.
Duplicate, stale, out-of-order or cross-sector commands fail closed; no retry or deduplication that can hide a repeated mutation.
A transport failure after authorization leaves completion ambiguous; only retained status and bounded readback may be requested.
On any error, invalidate staged data and mutation authorization. There is no command to clear a sticky failure.
Tokens are sequencing checks, not authentication or cryptographic nonces; a newly loaded plugin is a new session.
unresolved_before_mutation_enablement: Receive260 was physically observed once; general error/lifetime semantics remain unknown. Frozen staging plus exact host echo is independently required.
Root-managed footswitch recovery and exact candidate qualification; no new GPIO wiring or USB_KEY prerequisite is added.
Bounded poll counts tied to a reviewed erase/program timing budget; no unbounded WIP wait.
Malformed OUT framing/refusal policy without fallback into the ROM flash commands.
Host and target qualification evidence binding this exact writer, candidate image and unit backup.
